name: 29927 · Hardeeville, SC
findings: ZIP 29927 (Hardeeville) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29927 (Hardeeville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
